skills: Up to 4 Electric hits. The 4th gives 2 Venom, +1 on a Stunned enemy.

Hold with a Serpentine Shadow: leaps, locks on (hold and steer to aim longer) and slams for Electric DMG. Every 6 Venom gives 1 Shadow (max 3); she enters battle with 1. On hit, spends all Venom to trigger Corrode Bone. Triggers a Quick Assist.
Electric DMG around her; each trigger gives +6% CRIT Rate for 15s (max 3).
Leaping sweep for Electric DMG; can chain fast into her Special, EX Special or Serpent's Kiss.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Long-range snake bite for Electric DMG.

Several long-range bites for Electric DMG; refunds 5 Energy. Hold to spend up to 60 more Energy: +1 bite and +1 Venom per 20, plus 3 Venom for holding. Chains into the 4th Basic hit. Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.
Series of attacks for massive Electric DMG; gives 3 Venom. Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.
Downward smash for massive Electric DMG; gives 3 Venom and opens Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded for 30s (squad CRIT DMG +5%). Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.

core.name: Fatal Concoction
core.text:
Enters battle with 3 Venom (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). In combat she spends 1 Venom every 5s to trigger Corrode Bone; Venom past the cap triggers it once per extra point.
While she has Venom (and for 30s after), the squad's Electric DMG ignores {0}% DEF, plus {1}% per 0.12 initial Energy Regen above 1.4 (max {2}%).
Corrode Bone adds Electric DMG equal to {3}% of ATK, and deals 40% / 60% more Daze with 1 / 2 Electric squadmates.

ability.name: Festering Venom
ability.text: While she has Venom (and for 30s after), the squad gets +40% CRIT DMG, and she gets 10% more.

mindscapes: Enters battle with 6 Venom. Core Passive DEF ignore is 140% of normal, and the squad ignores 5% Electric RES. Corrode Bone ignores 10% Electric RES.
Chain or Ultimate hitting a Stunned enemy gives 3 more Venom. Serpent's Kiss deals +35% DMG.
EX Special, Chain and Ultimate give 1 Decidedness (max 3). Serpent's Kiss spends them all for free Corrode Bones (no Daze).
Each Corrode Bone gives 1 Bone-Deep Corrosion; any other squad hit spends one for a free Corrode Bone (no Daze, once per 3s).
